name: Seventh Heaven Uplands

start.dialog: Setting up a new bar here in the Uplands! But some local thugs keep causing trouble. I can handle myself, but I need someone to watch my back while I... convince them to leave. Interested?
start.objective: Help Tifa deal with thugs harassing her new bar

progress.dialog: They'll be back soon. Three of them. Big guys. I hope you're ready!
progress.objective: Defend the bar from the thug attack

complete.dialog: Thanks for the backup! Those guys won't bother anyone anymore. Here - premium bar supplies. Healing drinks, status cures, the good stuff. On the house!

party_comments.kade: She fights like a pro. And runs a bar? Impressive.
party_comments.twist: Did you see those moves?! I want to learn to fight like that!
party_comments.grit: Efficient combat style. Economy of motion.

hidden_outcome: If you defeat the thugs without Tifa taking damage, she teaches you 'Dolphin Blow' - a powerful aquatic-themed attack
